extDesc.message: Sends your downloads and video pages to the FastGrab app for faster, resumable downloads.

keyHint.message: Copy it from FastGrab → Settings → Browser extension.

captureHint.message: Programs, archives, videos, music and PDFs go to FastGrab. If FastGrab isn't open, the browser downloads them as usual.

grabVideo.message: Download the video on this page

grabPage.message: Find a video on this page

notRunning.message: Open FastGrab first, then try again.

needPairing.message: Paste the pairing key in the FastGrab extension first.

wrongKey.message: That key doesn't match. Copy it again from FastGrab's settings.
